## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and which issue (if any) is fixed.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature or expansion support
- [ ] Rules adjustment
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] Tested on both desktop and mobile screen sizes.
- [ ] Verified that existing browser `localStorage` data does not break on reload.
- [ ] Tested with the photo board visible and hidden.
- [ ] Updated `README.md` if new expansions or controls were added.
